title: Confidentiality of collaborative law communication.
bodyText: A collaborative law communication is confidential to the extent agreed by the parties in a signed record or as provided by law of this State other than this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§658G-16]  Confidentiality of collaborative law communication.  A collaborative law communication is confidential to the extent agreed by the parties in a signed record or as provided by law of this State other than this chapter. [L 2012, c 207, pt of §1]
